objective: Healthy, complete, fresh and decision-usable evidence by default; PARTIAL COVERAGE and DATA DEGRADED are exceptional, attributable and scoped states for genuine unresolved evidence gaps.

timeSemantics.retrievalAndCacheTime: bookkeeping only; never substitute for missing observation time
timeSemantics.unknownObservationTime: remain UNKNOWN; do not manufacture freshness from receipt/cache time

healthyCoverage.criticalRequiredEvidence: 100% decision-required capabilities have fresh or policy-valid warm/cached evidence, or a truthful scoped degradation is raised
healthyCoverage.optionalEvidence: optional provider failure does not contaminate unrelated symbol/desk/mode/app status

healthyCoverage.target: 100 for critical required evidence after eligible cache/fallback recovery

freshnessCompliance.target: 100 for decision-required observations within dataset/session policy

fallbackSuccess.target: maximize; eligible fallback attempted before avoidable degradation

degradationFrequency.target: avoid self-inflicted events from routing/cache/quota/scheduling/load defects

recoveryTime.target: automatic recovery after healthy evidence becomes available with hysteresis

quotaPressure.target: protect headroom for critical work before optional/background work

providerCallsAvoided.target: increase through valid cache reuse/coalescing/selection without freshness loss

partialCoverageReasons: some required capability evidence unavailable after eligible cache/fallback
required provider entitlement prevents full capability coverage
dataDegradedReasons: fallback exhausted or authority rule prevents substitution
prohibitedReasons: optional provider unavailable while required evidence healthy
preferred provider unavailable when eligible fallback/cache restores required evidence
retrieval timestamp is recent but provider observation time is unknown/stale

truthRules: Never hide a genuine data problem merely to appear healthy.
Direct-authority evidence is not rank-swapped by a secondary source.
Provider reachability or API-key presence does not promote lifecycle/authority.
Recovery clears degraded/partial state only when required evidence is actually healthy under policy.
